purpose: Reconnect simultaneous documentary recordings and photographs without weakening private-source, identity, collective-credit, or publication boundaries.

criteria.name: Bidirectional event reconciliation
criteria.passCondition: The method supports transcript-to-photograph and photograph-to-transcript research through a declared event anchor.

criteria.name: Private identity join
criteria.passCondition: Existing Apple Photos People associations may support retrieval only in the private layer; unnamed faces and sensitive traits are never inferred.

criteria.name: Prior-select calibration
criteria.passCondition: Nested _keep depth is a prior-curatorial signal, not proof of quality, identity, meaning, rights, consent, or publication suitability.

criteria.name: Complete family before hero selection
criteria.passCondition: A private event constellation retains sequences, near-duplicates, counterexamples, uncertainty, holds, and unclassified material before any public edit.

criteria.name: Non-destructive workspace
criteria.passCondition: Only additive membership pointers may be written inside the authorized Apple Photos workspace; source records and prior selects remain unchanged.

criteria.name: Publication remains human-gated
criteria.passCondition: Retrieval, prior public appearance, People association, or select depth never confers rights, consent, credit, dignity, caption, crop, accessibility, destination, or Jamie approval.

criteria.name: Bounded population honesty
criteria.passCondition: Every pass declares the event and source population searched, available private surfaces, unresolved matches, and bounded null findings.

humanGates: Jamie confirms event context and corrects transcript or People associations.
A photo editor reviews the complete candidate family and exact pixels.
Creator, represented-person, rights, consent, dignity, credit, crop, caption, alt-text, destination, and Jamie approvals remain open until the exact use is reviewed.
